note: Greenland is outside the EU and Schengen, but the nationalities that need a visa are those of the Schengen list, the visa a Danish one endorsed for Greenland (a Schengen visa doesn't admit): the eu1806 list's rules, the visa a separate one.

sources.title: The Danish Immigration Service, Entry to the Faroe Islands or Greenland (last updated 04-09-2026)
sources.said: A visa to enter Denmark or another Schengen country is not valid for entry into the Faroe Islands or Greenland. ... If you are a citizen of a visa-exempt country and can enter Denmark without a visa, you can also enter the Faroe Islands and Greenland without a visa.
